title: Father and Toddler in Wading Pool, 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A candid black-and-white 1956 snapshot featuring a smiling father sitting in a small backyard wading pool while balancing his young toddler on his shoulders. The photograph captures a heartwarming moment of postwar American suburban domestic life. The right margin displays an original developer stamp reading 'OCT • 56'.
